statement: Rename the method `FlagSet.SetAnnotation` to `SetFlagAnnotation`. Do not keep the old name as an alias or wrapper.

Let callers stop a flag walk early: change `FlagSet.VisitAll` and the package-level `VisitAll` so the callback returns a bool, `func(*Flag) bool`; returning false stops the walk. Existing callers that want every flag return true.

Rename the `Readlink` method of the `Symlink` interface to `ReadLink`, in the interface and in every type that implements it. Calls to the standard library's `os.Readlink` are not part of this change.
Rename `util.TempDir` to `util.MkdirTemp`, matching the standard library's `os.MkdirTemp`. Do not keep the old name.
Simplify `expfmt.MetricFamilyToText`: it should return only an `error`, not the number of bytes written.
Rename `expfmt.NewFormat` to `expfmt.FormatOf`. Do not keep the old name.
Rename the message type `PasteMsg` to `PasteEvent`. Do not keep the old name as an alias.
Change `Engine.Neighbors` in pkg/grove to take the edge kinds as a slice, `kinds []EdgeType`, instead of a variadic parameter. A nil or empty slice keeps meaning every kind.
